commit.message:
hdmitx: Remove registring with hdmi-audio-codec driver

The hdmitx audio playback uses hdmi-audio-codec driver, which has been
added with a capture patch in it from 5.15. Hence using this codec
driver creates extra capture device which is not needed. This patch fixes
this issue by using its own dai_driver.

Signed-off-by: Jagadeesh Banisetti <jagadeesh.banisetti@xilinx.com>

hdmitx: Remove registring with hdmi-audio-codec driver

The hdmitx audio playback uses hdmi-audio-codec driver, which has been
added with a capture patch in it from 5.15. Hence using this codec
driver creates extra capture device which is not needed. This patch fixes
this issue by using its own dai_driver.

Signed-off-by: Jagadeesh Banisetti <jagadeesh.banisetti@xilinx.com>

Set have_edid flag when HDMI-Tx connected

have_edid flag resets on HDMI-Tx disconnected, but not
set when HDMI-Tx again connected. This was causing EIO
error from hdmitx_audio_geteld().

Signed-off-by: Sunil Vaghela <sunil.vaghela@xilinx.com>
